services.desc: Our tasting room is located in Phoenixville, PA. We offer 6-8 rotating flavors on tap. Bring your own growler to fill up with your favorite brew. We also offer 5-gallon kegs and 12 oz bottles of our kombucha plus Turbo Squirrel, Baba's merch and other culinary delights. We are open every Saturday from 10 am till 3 pm.
